title: opx.config.json
description: Configuration for opx — front-end dev ops resources. Enabled-by-presence: a detector is enabled iff its short name appears in the relevant concern array.

lint.description: Languages/concerns to lint. Each entry is a short name ("js", "css") or fully-qualified package id.

overrides.description: Per-detector configuration overrides. Keys are detector short names; values map tool name → path of the user's override config.
